full_name: Andrea Louise Campbell | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2012–2013 Social Sciences Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow Massachusetts Institute of Technology
bio: Andrea Louise Campbell is a professor of political science at the Massachusetts Institute of Technology. Her work examines the intersection of public policies and mass politics (public opinion, political behavior, and political inequality), with a particular interest in the politics of social policy, health policy, and tax policy.
